frontmatter.name: notes-to-llms-txt
frontmatter.description: Draft a private llms family from mixed scratch text and meeting-note dumps: segment, cluster, preserve source facts/conflicts, redact secrets, then hand off to llms-deep-optimizer. TRIGGER: "/notes2llms", "turn these meeting notes into llms.txt", "draft an llms family from this mixed scratch dump". SKIP: reproducible local vault/export conversion with normalizer and lint gate → notes-to-llms; organize notes without llms output → note-organizer; maintained memory store → memory-to-llms-txt; one scoped concept → llms-concept-abstractor; existing- family audit → llms-deep-optimizer; new research → full-suite.

the request needs new research, not organizing existing notes (use /dr)
